reason: Adds a new planner/executor capability in a core join path: allowing aggregation on the inner side of index join. That directly changes physical plan generation in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go` and executor wiring/runtime behavior in aggregate executors and `builder.go`. Index join and aggregation are both high-blast-radius areas for correctness and semantic regressions, so this is important and risky enough for a focused Blocker/High review.
